scope: batch-7 Unit research draft for 12 unregistered Units; all planned; no evidence/PASS claimed

units.name: Unit ENV-II

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 0x44 + BMP280 0x76 composite on one Grove I2C bus; ENVUnit(..., type=2) drives both. SHT30 measure 0x2C10 returns 6B T/RH/CRC; BMP280 chip-id 0x58, calib 0x88 24B, data 0xF7 6B.
gaps: SHT30 heater/clock-stretching not exercised by the frozen driver
temperature/humidity/pressure physics NOT RUN

units.blocker: ENV-II has two fixed I2C addresses: SHT30 0x44 conflicts with ENV-III/ENV-IV SHT30 and Paper/HAT SHT30; BMP280 0x76 conflicts with bps/env/env-iv. Use one Unit per bus or PAHUB. Temperature/humidity/pressure physics and SHT30 heater/clock stretching are NOT RUN.
limitations: 0x44 and 0x76 are shared with existing Unit families; one Unit per bus only.
SHT30 CRC8 and BMP280 calibration compensation must be computed by the model, not returned as raw values.
Physical temperature/humidity/pressure accuracy, heater and response time are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit Mini BPS v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: QMP6988 barometer on I2C; product page and official I2C index say 0x56, but the frozen driver defaults to 0x70 and QMP6988 driver default is 0x70. Driver scans the first address and picks BMP280 (0x76) or QMP6988; QMP6988 chip-id 0x5C, reset 0xE6, calibration 0xA0 25B, data 0xF7 6B.
gaps: 0x56 vs 0x70 slave address unresolved
BMP280 QMP fallback detection depends on i2c.scan()[0] ordering
pressure physics/altitude datum NOT RUN

units.blocker: QMP6988 address is unresolved: product page + official I2C index say 0x56, frozen unit/bps.py and driver/qmp6988.py default to 0x70, and the official index lists ENV-III QMP6988 at 0x70. Evidence must scan 0x56/0x70 and verify chip-id 0x5C before choosing. 0x70 conflicts with env-iii/pahub; 0x76 BMP280 fallback conflicts with env/bps/env-ii/env-iv.
limitations: Page/index 0x56 vs driver 0x70 is a real unresolved conflict; do not silently pick one.
0x70 is shared with env-iii and pahub, 0x76 with ENV/BPS families; one Unit per bus.
Pressure physics, altitude datum and QMP6988 oversampling/IIR behavior are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit Mini IMU-Pro

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: 10-DoF composite: BMI270 0x68 (DIP can select secondary 0x69), BMM150 0x10 behind BMI270 auxiliary bus, BMP280 0x76 on the Grove bus. BMI270 needs an init blob (CMD 0x7E=0xB0) then aux config/read/write 0x44/0x4D/0x4E; magnetometer uses BMM150 behind that aux window.

registers.encoding: reg 0x0C accel x/y/z + gyro x/y/z int16 LE
0x44 aux config; 0x4D aux read; 0x4E aux write
mag x/y/z via BMI270 aux; chip-id 0x32

gaps: BMI270 init blob must be accepted by guest; QEMU needs aux window emulation
magnetometer/attitude physics NOT RUN

claims: Mini IMU-Pro: BMI270 0x68, BMP280 0x76; BMM150 0x10 on BMI270 aux bus 2

units.blocker: Composite sensor: BMI270 0x68 primary + BMM150 0x10 only reachable through BMI270 aux (0x44/0x4D/0x4E) + BMP280 0x76. 0x68 conflicts with mini-imu (U095); 0x76 conflicts with env/bps/env-ii/env-iv. BMI270 init blob and BMM150 aux transactions are the main implementation risk; attitude/magnetic/IMU physics NOT RUN.
limitations: BMM150 0x10 is behind BMI270 aux, not a direct Grove address; QEMU needs aux window emulation.
0x68/0x76 address conflicts; one Unit per bus only.
Acceleration/gyroscope/magnetometer/attitude and magnetic interference are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit HBridge v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: STM32F030 I2C motor driver at 0x20 (0x20-0x2F strap). Registers: 0x00 direction, 0x01 PWM8, 0x02 PWM16 LE, 0x04 PWM freq LE, 0x10 ADC8, 0x20 ADC16 LE, 0x30 VIN current float32 LE (v1.1), 0xFE fw, 0xFF address.
gaps: motor electrical/overcurrent protection NOT RUN
float32 byte order and INA199 scaling need guest evidence

units.blocker: 0x20 conflicts with the already-implemented HBridge U160 variant (one Unit per bus). v1.1 adds 0x30 float current detection; motor/current/overcurrent electrical behavior is NOT RUN and the float32 byte order must be proven by guest readback.
limitations: 0x20 is shared with Unit HBridge U160; one Unit per bus.
PWM16/frequency are little-endian; 0x30 is float32 little-endian (needs guest evidence).
Motor drive, RZ7899, INA199 current scaling, 3A limit and protection behavior are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit CardKB (original MEGA328P U035)

chips.part: MEGA328P (page product name) / MEGA8A (official I2C index)

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: 50-key QWERTY I2C keyboard at 0x5F, one-byte key register: read 1 byte, 0 = no key, non-zero = key code. Shift/Sym/Fn combinations are resolved inside the keyboard MCU; the host sees only final key bytes. KeyCode constants include BS/TAB/ENTER/ESC/SPACE/DEL and 180-183 arrows.
gaps: original MEGA328P vs v1.1 MEGA8A key map difference unresolved
keyboard matrix/mechanical/RGB LED behavior NOT RUN

units.blocker: 0x5F is shared with the registered cardkb U035-B (planned/unsupported); only one CardKB version per bus. The original board is MEGA328P per the product page while the official I2C index lists MEGA8A; key-code differences and the 50-key matrix/RGB LED are unresolved/NOT RUN.
limitations: 0x5F conflicts with Unit CardKB v1.1 (U035-B); one Unit per bus.
Original MEGA328P vs index MEGA8A and v1.1 key map differences are unresolved.
Keyboard matrix, mechanical feel, RGB LED and combo-key firmware behavior are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit Mini ToF-90°

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: VL53L0X ToF ranging at 0x29, 3-200 cm, 25° FoV, 940nm VCSEL, 8-23 ms; the 90° is the laser module mounting orientation only. unit/tof.py aliases driver.vl53l0x.VL53L0X; range status/data registers and clear-interrupt flow are identical to Unit ToF U010.
gaps: VL53L0X init sequence/limit-calibration must be modeled
laser optics/accuracy/940nm NOT RUN

units.blocker: 0x29 is four-way shared with Unit ToF (U010, planned/unsupported), Unit Color (U009), and Unit ToF4M (U172 implemented). Mini ToF-90 is VL53L0X like U010 (not VL53L1X); one Unit per bus. 90° optics/laser/range accuracy are NOT RUN.
limitations: 0x29 conflicts with tof U010, tof4m U172 and color U009; one Unit per bus.
VL53L0X and VL53L1X init/registers must not be mixed; Mini ToF-90 is VL53L0X.
Laser optics, 940nm safety, FoV/accuracy and 3-200 cm physics are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit HEX

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: 37x SK6812 RGB LEDs on the yellow signal line, white NC; output-only RMT data stream (no readback). Public UIFlow2 has no unit/hex.py; only generic driver.neopixel.sk6812.SK6812 (GRB order, bpp=3) is executable. HEX can cascade via its input/output ports.

registers.encoding: 37 LEDs x 3 bytes GRB, 800kHz RMT stream (generic driver ORDER GRB)
data in/out pass-through for chained HEX panels

gaps: No official unit/hex.py; generic SK6812 path only
SK6812 vs WS2812C timing/order differences
LED optics/power/cascade timing NOT RUN

claims: neohex 37-LED RMT capture on yellow data line

units.blocker: No official unit/hex.py driver; executable reference is generic driver.neopixel.sk6812.SK6812 (GRB, 37 LEDs). SK6812 timing/order differs from A045-B neohex WS2812C, and PORT.B yellow data conflicts with neohex/rgb-led-10cm/op90. LED optics, power and cascade behavior are NOT RUN.
limitations: No official Unit HEX driver: guest probe must use generic NeoPixel/SK6812, unlike a frozen unit driver.
SK6812 (HEX A045) vs WS2812C (NeoHEX A045-B) timing/order/cascade differences unresolved until measured.
PORT.B yellow data line shared with neohex/rgb-led-10cm/op90; one output Unit per port.
LED optics/color/power/cascade input-output NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit Mini PDM

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SPM1423 PDM MEMS microphone, two-wire PDM: yellow=DATA input, white=CLK output. No I2C/UART register map and no public UIFlow2 Unit driver; guest must use machine.I2S PDM RX (or a future unit/mini_pdm wrapper). Data plane is a PCM stream, not register transactions.

registers.encoding: 1-bit PDM DATA sampled on CLK, decimated to PCM by I2S/PDM RX
host-generated PDM clock; frequency selects power/sleep per product page

gaps: No official Unit driver/API; guest path is machine.I2S only
Acoustic sensitivity/SNR/THD NOT RUN
PDM pinmux/clock frequency not verified on cores3 PORT.B

claims: SPM1423 PDM RX path exists for ESP32 AtomU/Echo boards
ESP32-S3 I2S RX DMA with rx_pcm injection

units.blocker: No official UIFlow2 Unit driver for Mini PDM; only machine.I2S/PDM RX can be exercised. QEMU already has ESP32 SPM1423 PDM RX (AtomU/Echo) and ESP32-S3 I2S RX front-end, but a Unit attachment + PCM fixture interface must be added. Acoustic behavior is NOT RUN.
limitations: No official Unit driver: evidence path is machine.I2S PDM, weaker than a frozen unit driver.
PORT.B DATA/CLK two-wire use conflicts with hex RMT and other PORT.B units.
Acoustic sensitivity/SNR/THD/clock frequency and enclosure acoustics NOT RUN.

id + data bytes, extframe/rtr flags; standard 11-bit / extended 29-bit

External CAN bus/transceiver/isolation/termination NOT RUN
Unit attachment for CAN frames and host injection unresolved

cores3 board creates m5_can_bus_create() CanBusState and realizes TWAI
